posts.title: Dependency Resolution via Natural Join
posts.description: Package managers generally use SAT solvers 1 for dependency resolution, walking the solution space, backtracking on conflicts, to find a resolution. This article will explain how a dependency resolution algorithm to find the whole solution space can be defined as a sequence of natural joins, and discuss the feasibility of implementing such an algorithm. It’s based on conversations with Gershom Baz
